evals.prompt: 参考 bk-cmdb 的 release.md 风格，帮我为 bk-nodemgr support-files 设计一套 changelog 模板，重点覆盖 Agent、Plugin、Package、兼容性和已知问题。
evals.expected_output: A reusable Markdown changelog template with version heading, release scope, feature/fix categories, compatibility, and known issues.
expectations: Output preserves a reusable versioned Markdown template instead of inventing concrete release facts.
Output includes a version heading in the form `## [Version: ...] - ...`.
Output includes release scope sections for Agent, Plugin, and Package.
Output includes compatibility and known-issues sections.

evals.prompt: 我准备发一个版本，变更包括：优化 Linux Agent 安装速度；修复 Windows 插件下发失败；新增插件包校验；要求补一份发布说明。请按 bk-nodemgr 风格生成 changelog。
evals.expected_output: A concrete release note that classifies the supplied facts into feature/optimization/fix sections and includes release scope plus compatibility considerations.
expectations: Output classifies the supplied facts into feature, optimization, and fix style sections instead of listing them flatly.
Output identifies the affected release scope, including Agent, Plugin, or Package when relevant.
Output includes compatibility-impact framing rather than only restating implementation changes.
Output uses release-facing wording instead of raw engineering detail.

evals.prompt: 给我写一个 v3.1.0 的 changelog 草稿，但我现在只知道有 Agent 协议调整和插件仓库兼容性变化，其他信息还不全。
evals.expected_output: A reader-facing draft with supported facts only and separate author-facing verification items; no unverified compatibility or release facts invented or published.
expectations: Output keeps the standard changelog structure even though the facts are incomplete.
Unknown details are reported to the author outside the changelog body instead of being guessed or inserted as `待确认`.
Output does not invent missing date, tag range, compatibility conclusion, or release-scope requirements.
Output treats Agent protocol and plugin repository changes as leads to verify, not confirmed release effects; no final changelog file is written while essential facts remain unverified.

evals.prompt: 请基于 `v2.3.0...v2.4.0` 的 tag diff 整理一版 bk-nodemgr changelog，要求先看版本间变化，再归类成新增、优化、修复、兼容性和已知问题。
evals.expected_output: A changelog workflow/output that treats tag-to-tag diff as the primary evidence source, then synthesizes user-facing release notes instead of copying raw commit messages.
expectations: Output treats the `v2.3.0...v2.4.0` compare range as the primary evidence source.
Output synthesizes release-facing conclusions instead of copying raw commit messages verbatim.
Output organizes the result into feature, optimization, fix, compatibility, and known-issues sections.
If concrete facts are missing, output gives author-facing gaps separately and keeps the reader-facing text a draft rather than pretending the diff was fully analyzed.

evals.prompt: 模板中要生成一个类似于 `Full Changelog: [v3.0.1-alpha.15...v3.0.1-alpha.16](https://github.com/TencentBlueKing/bk-nodemgr/compare/v3.0.1-alpha.15...v3.0.1-alpha.16)` 的 compare 链接。
evals.expected_output: A changelog template/output that includes a GitHub compare-style Full Changelog link under the version heading, using the exact from-tag...to-tag range.
expectations: Output includes a `Full Changelog` compare link directly under the version heading.
Link text uses the exact same `from-tag...to-tag` range as the URL target.
Output keeps the compare range as `v3.0.1-alpha.15...v3.0.1-alpha.16` without rewriting or truncating it.
If the range is uncertain, the skill reports the link gap to the author instead of putting `待确认` in the document; a planned target-tag link is verified at the publication gate.
